name: Wide Pulse
description: Send a wide slow pulse over a whole town and read the souls that answer it.

name: Absence Seek
description: Seek out every empty place where a soul should be and is not.

name: Deep Rinse
description: Rinse one ally's soul clean of the residue left by a vast soul attack.

name: Kin Link
description: Link the sensing of the user to a kinsman so that distance means nothing between them.

name: Region Reading
description: Read an entire region of souls and sort them by strength and by goodwill.

name: Sky Ward
description: Spread a ward of soul across the whole sky above the user and all allies beneath it.

name: Dread Sweep
description: Sweep a wave of pure dread across the field so that every foe's soul recoils at once.

name: Recalling Voice
description: Call one fallen ally's soul back with a great voice of will if the ally has only just stopped breathing.

name: Heaven Hearing
description: Hear every soul under the heavens as a single vast murmur and pick out any one by name.

name: Laid Bare
description: Lay every soul in reach bare so that its hidden fears are shown to the user and its own thoughts turn on it.

name: Hundredfold Rinse
description: Cleanse a hundred allies of taint and fear in one wide wash of calm soul force.

name: World Chorus
description: Raise every ally into a chorus that shares one great sense across the field with a reach that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Secretless Sky
description: Make every soul beneath a whole sky known to the user at once in mood and intent and nearest memory so that none can hide.

name: Distant Choir
description: Hear the souls of a far town as a choir and tell which voice is raised in alarm.

name: Core Hearken
description: Hearken with the core itself and feel the weight of every cultivator within a wide ring.

name: Mending Stillness
description: Lay a mending hush over one ally and draw the sting of a soul wound out of it.

name: Anchor Lend
description: Lend the steadiness of the core to one ally so that the ally's soul does not drift.

name: Land Pulse
description: Feel the whole pulse of a land as a single slow heartbeat and mark where it falters.

name: Stilling Ward
description: Still the air so utterly that every hostile soul technique within reach dies before it forms.

name: Heavy Quiet
description: Drop a heavy quiet over the foe's whole mind so that thought itself stalls.

name: Life Recall
description: Pull an ally's soul back from the very edge of death within a few breaths of the final blow.

name: Realm Hearing
description: Hear the souls of an entire realm at once and trace each cry to its source.

name: Great Unveiling
description: Unveil every concealed soul and every veiled art in reach and tear the veils from them.

name: Company Wash
description: Wash a whole army clean of fear and curse and soul erosion with one deep swell of calm.

name: Land Ken
description: The school's closing move that opens the core to the whole land and reads every soul upon it to a depth that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Silence Sovereign
description: Impose a sovereign silence on every soul within a vast ring so that no technique can be spoken and no will can be raised.

name: Answering Stillness
description: Answer a land's cry with a stillness that cleanses every soul it covers and shows the user each one.
